title: Source-conditioned core switch from a true empty-minority endpoint
statement: At A=D=1,B=0,E=q>=0,C=B+s1,F=E+s2,s1,s2>=n>0,the unconditional joint event(first block source1_i,then the next block event is the other source1,before own source2) is at most3 alpha_i1/(2 alpha_i2 n). Uniform in q,gap ratio and positive core rates;no q/n restriction.

requires: Actual point input at the empty B endpoint,not a stationary or supplied entrance law;anchors1,1 and both negative gaps>=n.

True finite birth/death core with all competing block hazards. Acquire actual killed Green nu=delta0(-Q+H)^-1 and monotone f=nu/mu. Observe each stage until its next actual block event;other competing exits remain live.
provides: Source-weighted competing-switch bound;sum over ports bounds two phase1 activations before either source2.
Exact retag mu_post=mu/(C_i+1) and post/pre conductance<=2/n control the Dirichlet pairing.
assumptions: Reference mu is acquired by raw edge ratios and need not normalize;it is not the incoming law.
costs: Both actual core Green operators and shifted source hazards retained. The probability lemma alone is not a clock/return theorem;the composite corner separately pays time/noncore reward.
contract.units: Unconditional joint-event probability,raw rates and actual Green occupation.
contract.obstruction: No same1/n estimate for arbitrary interior or balanced inputs without their own Green/energy control. No stationary reset,mixing gap,whole recurrence or practical solver advantage.

evidence.quote: # A paid source-conditioned switch, without an entrance-profile or gap
evidence.range_scope: Read the full native-receiver domain,zero-angular guard and true endpoint Green assumptions.

body: Author uniform source construction;finite exact kernels support cases only. The proof comparison may omit an extra own hazard only to upper-bound the bad event;the actual physical operation retains all channels. Original Z-trace failure remains an antecedent,not a disproved result.

review.scope: Same warm author;root read two proofs,not a new independent audit. Programs/results preserved,not imported or rerun;no P3 held source.
